text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. `.sdlc/runs/20261105-000000-feature-new-rich-text-spans/requirements.md` has been generated and validated with all required sections:

- **In scope**: Numbered, testable scope items covering the `TextStyleRange` data model on `ExcalidrawTextElement`, pure range operations in `packages/element/src/textStyleRanges.ts`, WYSIWYG selection tracking and colour actions, Canvas 2D run/highlight rendering, static SVG `<tspan>` and highlight `<rect>` export, and persistence/restore/lifecycle support.
- **Out of scope**: Per-span font metrics, `contenteditable` replacement, inline markup syntax, dependency/build changes, and edits outside the frozen write contract.
- **Functional requirements per module (`FR-1` – `FR-12`)**: Grounded in existing packages (`@excalidraw/element` and `@excalidraw/excalidraw`) and modules.
- **Non-functional requirements (`NFR-1` – `NFR-5`)**: Including backward compatibility for legacy saved scenes and unstyled text elements, pure deterministic range operations, unstyled fast-path rendering, dark-mode parity, and write-scope hygiene.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix**: Documenting data sensitivity/protection and role×resource×action mappings.
- **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1` – `AC-7`)**: Executable via `yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false`.
- **Open questions for HITL**: None.
